class.name: cyton_trac_ik_kinematics_plugin/TracIKKinematicsPlugin
class.description: MoveIt2-native TRAC-IK kinematics plugin for the Cyton Gamma 1500 -- wraps external/trac_ik's core solver (compiled directly, not a copy), built specifically to A/B compare against the KDL plugin. See trac_ik_kinematics_plugin.hpp's own header comment for what this is and is not (not a port of the ROS1 trac_ik_kinematics_plugin.cpp).
